subject.title: Create codex / claude plugins for each crawler

question: Should per-crawler assistant bundles be owned and published by each downstream crawler, maintained in a separate shared plugin repository, or standardized through a new crawlkit packaging surface?
rationale: The requested capability is missing, but repository policy does not decide the cross-repository and cross-marketplace ownership model; implementing it here prematurely could violate crawlkit's provider-neutral boundary.

options.title: Downstream-owned bundles
options.body: Have each crawler own and publish its native command skills, sharing conventions informally until a reusable abstraction is demonstrated.

options.title: Separate shared repository
options.body: Create a dedicated repository for common manifests and higher-level workflows while keeping crawler-native skills in downstream apps.

options.title: Crawlkit packaging surface
options.body: Add a provider-neutral bundle API here now and require downstream crawlers to consume it.

recommendation.title: Downstream-owned bundles
recommendation.body: Have each crawler own and publish its native command skills, sharing conventions informally until a reusable abstraction is demonstrated.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared-library boundary originates in their work, making them the strongest available routing candidate for deciding whether a new cross-crawler abstraction belongs in crawlkit.
